speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand the cause of your right knee swelling, could you please describe when the symptoms started and if there was any specific injury or trauma involved? Additionally, can you tell me more about the "similar problems" in your family history?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Is the knee red or warm to the touch, and has he had any recent fevers or illnesses? Also, does he have a history of easy bruising or bleeding, such as from minor cuts or after vaccinations?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Swelling of the right knee. I also have No recent trauma or injury, Familial history of similar symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Has your son experienced any spontaneous bleeding from his gums, nose, or heavy bruising with minor bumps? I would also like to know if he has had any previous episodes of joint swelling or pain in other areas, such as elbows or ankles.
